entries.german: Kaufbrief des Jörg von Rosenberg und seiner Ehefrau Margaretha über ihre Teile an dem Schloss und Dorf Eubigheim ("Eubikein") mit Zugehörungen.
entries.english: Georg von Rosenberg and his wife Margaretha issued a deed of sale concerning their shares in Eubigheim Castle and village, together with their appurtenances.

facts.content: sold his and his wife Margaretha’s shares in Eubigheim Castle and village with their appurtenances.
